title: Printable area sheet: triangles (lesson 11)
subject: Mathematics
source: Seeded from mathematics/y8 lesson 11 (Printable area sheet: triangles (portal worksheet for this lesson))
intro: Lesson 11: Area of a triangle. To understand why the area of a triangle is half the base times the perpendicular height and use it in problems

model.title: A triangle has base 9 cm, perpendicular height 6 cm and slant side 7 cm. Find its area.
A triangle has area 30 cm² and base 12 cm. Find its height.

questions.q: Find the area of a triangle with base 8 cm and perpendicular height 5 cm.

A triangle has area 48 cm² and height 8 cm. Find its base.

A triangle has vertices (1, 1), (7, 1) and (4, 6). Find its area.
Two triangles share a base of 10 cm, one above it with height 6 cm and one below with height 9 cm, making a kite. Find the kite's area.
The area of a triangle with base 10 cm and height 6 cm is:
Big question: why is a triangle's area half a rectangle's?
questions.a: Two copies of the triangle fill the rectangle with the same base and height, so it is half of b × h.
